header: The old way against yours, one row at a time
lead: Two labelled columns and one row per point, so the contrast reads line by line instead of paragraph by paragraph. The claimed column is tinted, which is what gives the eye a lane to follow.
note: Where there is nothing to compare against, the included checklist says the same thing without inventing an opponent.
